distractors.reason: We don't say 'make the deadline'. 'Make' is used with decisions, plans and mistakes.
We don't say 'do the deadline'. 'Do' is used with tasks such as homework and the dishes.
We don't say 'take the deadline'. 'Take' is used with breaks, photos and notes.

example_sentence: We must ___ the deadline for our project.
l1_interference: Türkçe konuşanlar 'yetişmek' fiilini 'make' ya da 'do' ile karıştırabilir. İngilizcede zaman sınırı için 'meet' kullanılır: 'meet the deadline'.
explanation: In English, 'meet' is used when you reach a target or time limit on time, such as a deadline, a goal or a standard.

related_collocations.example: I want to meet my goal by the end of the year.
I will give a presentation about my project.
We made good progress last week.

memory_tip: MEET = reach a time limit or target (meet the deadline) | MAKE = create (make a plan) | DO = perform a task (do the work)
